comment: Local NHS service finders (decision record, 2026-09-22): impartial signposting — the patient finds a service near them on the NHS website's own finder. `items` are links on NHS.uk's Services A to Z index (fetched, never typed); each carries a `patient` block: fixed navigation steps, NHS.uk patient sentences copied from the fetched page (rendered only while verified; re-checked weekly), and the standing 111/999 line. PUBLIC file: NHS.uk only, no provider, phone, address, person, price, module or note — the professional layer lives on the medrics server (decision record, 2026-09-22 (2): separation of the professional picker from what the public sees).

steps: Tap the button below. It opens the NHS website.
Type your postcode or town.
Choose one near you and contact them in the way the NHS page shows.

nhs.label: Toothache
nhs.anchor: See a dentist if you have toothache that lasts more than 2 days
nhs.quote: See a dentist if you have toothache that lasts more than 2 days. They can treat the cause of the pain and stop any problems getting worse. There are also things you can do to ease toothache while you wait for an appointment.

nhs.label: Dental abscess
nhs.anchor: It needs urgent treatment by a dentist
nhs.quote: A dental abscess is a build-up of pus in the teeth or gums caused by an infection. It needs urgent treatment by a dentist. A dental abscess will not go away on its own.

nhs.quote: If you're concerned about your sight before your next NHS sight test is due, you should visit your ophthalmic practitioner or optometrist.
